definition: Stable research-record identifier (PAH-nnn). A record is an entry in the library, not a unique study.
allowed_values: PAH-001 to PAH-079; PAH-020 not used

definition: Relevance of the record to installed art in healthcare.
allowed_values: Healthcare art; Adjacent evidence; Mechanisms; Practice; Policy & context
notes: Relevance, not confidence

definition: Design or kind of material.
allowed_values: Randomised trial; Observational / experimental; Cross-sectional mixed-methods study; Qualitative study (as described); Descriptive survey; Uncontrolled evaluation; Review; Theory; Research gap; Programme / guidance; Policy / context

definition: Kind of evidence, not a quality grade.
allowed_values: Outcome research; Practice documentation; Mechanism or theory; Policy or guidance
notes: Derived from scope and type in Edition 4.6; see evidence_family_basis

definition: How sculpture figures in the record.
allowed_values: Isolated intervention; Part of a mixed collection or intervention; Outside healthcare; Discussed without evaluation; No sculpture component; Not yet coded
notes: Coded for sculpture-related records and PAH-077 to PAH-079

definition: Permanence of the art encountered, as established by the source. The study’s observation period is recorded separately and does not establish permanence.
allowed_values: Permanent; Temporary; Simulated; Unclear; free text where combined; Not yet coded

definition: How people encountered the art; combined components listed separately.
allowed_values: Incidental viewing; Deliberate unguided viewing; Facilitated viewing; Touch or interaction; Art-making; Not reported; Not yet coded

definition: Summary label for the record; full findings take precedence.
allowed_values: Reported benefit; Mixed findings; Includes null findings; Includes unfavourable findings; Context / synthesis
notes: Applies to the record, not every outcome

definition: What has been assessed, and when.
allowed_values: Full text assessed; Abstract checked; Abstract assessed (earlier wording); Abstract or primary source checked; Secondary account; Not recorded in structured form; Independently reviewed (not yet used); Not yet coded

definition: Bibliographic overlap and cohort relationship note; not a unique-study identifier.
allowed_values: Free text
notes: Two confirmed shared-publication groups are documented in Edition 4.11; source-by-source and participant-level reconciliation remains incomplete.

definition: Outcome-level data (measure, time point, denominator, result, uncertainty).
allowed_values: Not yet extracted; Structured summary extracted
notes: Structured summaries for PAH-016 PAH-031 and PAH-038 added in Edition 4.8 (field structured_summary in JSON)

definition: Retired A–E grade from earlier editions.
allowed_values: A–E or empty
notes: Historical metadata only; not a current rating; not GRADE

definition: Stable installation identifier (W-nn). One record is one artwork, or one ensemble presented as a single work, at one institution.
allowed_values: W-01 to W-36
notes: Published identifiers are retained

definition: Kind of source the record cites.
allowed_values: Institution or artist source; Independent sources only; Awaiting institutional confirmation
notes: Not a claim that every detail is verified

definition: Date the source category was assigned.
allowed_values: ISO date
notes: Not a date of full verification

definition: Which details were checked against a named source, and when.
allowed_values: Free text; "Not yet completed claim by claim"
notes: See the verification ledger

definition: What is known about whether the work is in place.
allowed_values: Free text; "Not confirmed..."
notes: Historical sources do not confirm present location

definition: Date an enquiry was sent to the institution.
allowed_values: ISO date or null

definition: Whether an image is displayed.
allowed_values: Displayed; Withdrawn (with date and reason); No image: awaiting permission

definition: Publication basis for a displayed image.
allowed_values: Licence name, or supplied by the founder
notes: Photo permission and artwork-reproduction review are separate

definition: Outcome evidence about this work.
allowed_values: Study linked; No eligible study identified in the sources reviewed; Not yet searched

definition: Evidence about a collection that includes the work.
allowed_values: Record IDs; Not assessed
notes: Never attributed to the individual work

definition: Participation in selection or design.
allowed_values: Free text; "Not published"
notes: Missing information is not "no consultation"

definition: Work by the site founder.
allowed_values: true / false
notes: Disclosed example of practice; not evidence of health benefit

definition: The published detail being tracked.
allowed_values: title; attribution; institution; location; material; dimensions; date; current status

definition: Whether the claim has been checked.
allowed_values: Checked against source; Conflicting sources; Not yet checked claim by claim

definition: Whether an enquiry to the institution was sent and retained.
allowed_values: Sent (date; correspondence retained); Prepared, not sent (reason); Not yet prepared

definition: Date of the latest source documenting the work at its recorded location.
allowed_values: ISO date or year; null if not recorded
notes: Not a confirmation of current placement

definition: Date the displayed photograph was taken or published.
allowed_values: ISO date; null if not recorded
notes: Kept separate from last_documented_source_date

definition: Who performed the check.
allowed_values: Editorial team
notes: An independent reviewer has not yet been appointed

definition: Whether the record documents placement or a project still in progress.
allowed_values: Documented placement (current status varies); Installation in progress
notes: Documented placement does not confirm present location.

definition: Date the record data was last updated.
allowed_values: ISO date
notes: Separate from the last full editorial audit; does not imply full-text or independent review.

definition: Existing record-level verification statement carried into the current snapshot.
allowed_values: Free text
notes: Not a new verification performed during the technical QC release.

definition: Date the ledger was reconciled to the published data.
allowed_values: ISO date
notes: Not the date of verification of each claim.

definition: Confirmed shared-publication group IDs; not unique-study IDs.
Other record IDs sharing a confirmed publication.
Permanent English research-record URL.
Date of the bibliographic relationship update, not a new study appraisal.
